_comment: Single source of truth for AI provider taxonomy. Edit this file to add/remove providers or models — both the BE (src/bootstrap/nodes.ts default-fallback) and FE (src/byok/lib/providers.ts wizard) read from here at boot. Pricing is per-1K-token to match the existing FE display format (multiply by 1000 for per-1M). All data verified against each provider's official docs in May 2026.

providers.label: Anthropic
providers.description: Claude 4 family. Strong reasoning, tool use, long context.
providers.apiKeyHelpText: Your key stays in the sample BE's sqlite-backed BYOK store (AES-256-GCM at rest). Real deploys swap for KMS.
providers.customModelHelp: e.g. a model snapshot like `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` or a beta release.

providers.label: OpenAI
providers.description: GPT-5 family. 1M context window, broad ecosystem support.
providers.apiKeyHelpText: Your key stays in the sample BE's sqlite-backed BYOK store (AES-256-GCM at rest). Real deploys swap for KMS.
providers.customModelHelp: e.g. `gpt-5.4-nano`, a fine-tune `ft:gpt-5.4-mini:org:name:id`, or a preview.

providers.label: Google
providers.description: Gemini 2.5 family. Very long context, fast streaming, multimodal.
providers.apiKeyHelpText: Your key stays in the sample BE's sqlite-backed BYOK store (AES-256-GCM at rest). Real deploys swap for KMS.
providers.customModelHelp: e.g. `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` or any model id from the Gemini model catalog. Note: gemini-2.0-flash is deprecated and sunsets 2026-06-01 — don't use it.
providers._notes: Flash-Lite is the recommended default — 8× output cap and avoids the 2.5-family reasoning-budget issue that can return empty completions when maxOutputTokens is exhausted by internal thinking.
